messages:
incidents-bot: Paging detected: elevated 5xx rate for Dedicated cluster eu-west-1 affecting tenant `morro-corp` (enterprise). 5xx spike > 12% over 5m, service: /api/v1/generate. Ops team alerted. :rotating_light:
ops-ana: Ack. I'm on it — collecting logs + scaling checks. tagging @raj (SRE).
raj (SRE): Oncall here. preliminary check: qps normal, error pattern shows downstream KV timeouts around 2026-03-17T09:08Z. Pulling kube events and recent deploys.
ops-ana: Rolling through `kubectl get pods -n redwood-dedicated-eu -o wide` — one replica in pool-dedicated-7 shows CrashLoopBackOff. Attaching last 3 lines of pod log:
```
[2026-03-17T09:07:54Z] ERR kvclient: timeout contacting kv-node-5 (timeout=120ms)
[2026-03-17T09:08:03Z] WARN upstream: transient EOF
[2026-03-17T09:08:12Z] ERR model-runtime: failed to fetch kv shard, returning 502
```
raj (SRE): Looks like partial KV node degradation causing cache misses -> cascade 5xx. I'll isolate pod and restart kv proxy on that node.
emma (Account Ops): Heads-up — Morro is premium enterprise with active on-call SLAs. Their primary contacts are on our escalation list. Recommend we hit them with a short tailored notice now.
sara (Solutions): Draft status line for Morro: "We are investigating increased errors impacting text generation for Morro Corp in eu-west-1. Our engineers are performing targeted restarts and routing traffic to healthy replicas. We will provide an update within 30 minutes." Works?
julie (Support): Good. Also include instructions for customers using pinned model versions (they may see 502s). Add link to temporary workaround: use fallback model `redwood-bert-small` if tolerated.
ops-ana: Agreed. I'm going to execute controlled restart of kv-proxy on node-5 now: `ssh ops@node-5 && sudo systemctl restart kv-proxy` and cordon the node if restarts fail. Patching in progress.
raj (SRE): Restart done. Observability shows 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 3% over 90s. CPU and mem stable. Continuing to monitor.
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-17-1201. Paging window open. Severity: S2. Notifying infra rotation.
emma (Account Ops): Sending tailored email to Morro Ops contacts now (short):
```
Subject: Redwood Inference - Active incident affecting Morro Corp (eu-west-1)
Hi team,
We're currently investigating elevated errors affecting your text generation calls in eu-west-1. Engineers have identified transient KV node issues and have restarted the affected proxy. Traffic is routing to healthy replicas; you may see intermittent 502/5xx for ~5-15 minutes. We'll update again within 30 minutes or when resolved.
- Emma, Redwood Account Ops
```
ops-ana: Status page blurb queued (ops/status): "Investigating: Elevated error rates for Dedicated eu-west-1 impacting a small subset of enterprise customers. Workaround: automatic routing to healthy replicas enabled."
julie (Support): Logged customer-facing ticket in CRM and flagged for priority; added contact notes.
sara (Solutions): Routing decision: keep fallback routing enabled for pinned versions for next 45m. If 5xx >5% after that, initiate partial failover to another AZ.
raj (SRE): Monitoring p95 latency and error counts. Setting an alert: `errors>5% for 2m` to trigger paging.
ops-ana: Quick postmortem notes to capture in incident: root cause suspected: KV node transient overload/timeouts; mitigation: restart proxy and enable routing to healthy replicas; next steps: deeper KV health check, capacity tuning.
emma (Account Ops): Morro Ops replied: "Thanks — appreciated the rapid update. Keep us posted on ETA to full recovery."
ops-ana: Follow-up: 5xx stabilized < 2% for Morro. I'll still run a full KV scrub and bring node-5 back under normal rotation by EOD. Handoff to next oncall: @raj will monitor for the next 2h.
raj (SRE): Taking handoff. Will update if we see a regression.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-17-1201 status -> monitoring.
ops-ana: Closing notes posted to incident channel and attaching commands run + logs for postmortem. Moving ticket to "investigate" for follow-through tasks. :white_check_mark:
